scope: Synthetic local characterization; no production access

findings.result: TAT: zero/empty real response produces a 45-minute median and hardcoded gauge counts.
QC engine returns PASS for nonnumeric measurement.
10x produces WARNING in the operational QC evaluator and REJECT in qcEngine.
A panel containing an empty Draft and one Approved analyte is displayed as Approve.
A multi-test tube plus its two result products creates three worklist entries, including a composite phantom test.
Batch validation reports one validated result even when every write fails.
Release event emitted despite zero successful approval writes.
Exported archive helper reports a default freezer location for an unknown barcode; no main UI caller found.
Simulator parser accepts an empty frame and fabricates an accession; not the production connector parser.
Autoverify frontend ignores normal_min/normal_max and expects ref_low/ref_high.
Archived SQL RPC reclassifies a critical Released result as Validated without evaluating QC/rule/status/tenant. Deployment not verified.
